# REF001: dangling-ticket-ref

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| family | REF |
| product | frob |
| severity (default) | error |
| tier | universal |
| scope | file |
| fix | manual |
| polarity | P+ |
| must_measure | true |
| version | 1 |
| since | 2.0.0 |

A `frob:ticket` directive names a ticket that is not in the ledger.

The full ULID resolves to no ticket. Abbreviated ids never reach this rule:
the scanner reports them as DSL002 and keeps no directive. Fix the id or
file the ticket. Not evaluated without a ledger.

## Examples

### REF001 dangling ticket references / Fires on an unknown full ULID #1 (line 6) (fire)

```rust
/* frob:ticket 01J9QKX3M8Z4T7N2V5B6C0D1E2 */ // error: REF001
fn a() {}
```

### REF001 dangling ticket references / Fires on an unknown v1 alias, in ticket and todo #2 (line 13) (fire)

```rust
/* frob:ticket T-9999 */ // error: REF001
fn a() {}
/* frob:todo T-9998 later */ // error: REF001
fn b() {}
```

### REF001 dangling ticket references / Clean for open and done tickets #3 (line 22) (clean)

```rust
/* frob:ticket {{OPEN}} */
fn a() {}
/* frob:ticket {{DONE}} */
fn b() {}
```
